fields.summary_ko.0: Fortinet (NASDAQ:FTNT) share price plunged 22% to nearly five-month lows, despite the company's third annual revenue guidance raise this year.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 product revenue increased 37%, total revenue grew 20%, and billings surged 29% to $230M, though service revenue growth lagged at 13%, raising market concerns.
fields.summary_ko.2: Service revenue represents over 65% of total revenue but annual service revenue guidance was cut by less than 1%, raising concerns of potential slowdown in the company's high-growth trajectory following a 120% year-to-date share price gain.
